$comment: Speaker library of the setup wizard. One entry per cabinet; a multi-way cabinet driven bi-amp has one section per way. impedance_ohm and aes_w are the section's totals (all its drivers, as wired inside the cabinet); sensitivity_db is 1 W / 1 m. 'estimated' lists the values not taken from a datasheet of these exact drivers.

sections.name: Sub
sections.source: Driver: B&C 21DS115 datasheet (8 Ω). Range and sensitivity: the TH1821 plan's simulation, made with another 21" driver.

sections.name: Kick
sections.source: MKH-230 plan. No MB12G401 datasheet found: power from its neighbour, the MB12G301 (8 Ω, 400 W AES).

speakers.name: T24N clone (bi-amp)
speakers.description: 2× Sanway 12W76ND-8 + Sanway DE800-8 on a 1.4" horn

sections.name: Low
sections.source: Sanway 12W76ND-8 datasheet (400 W AES, 100 dB 1 W/1 m each, +3 dB for two). Low end: the original TW Audio T24N.

sections.name: High
sections.source: Sanway DE800-8 datasheet: 100 W, 108 dB for the driver alone (the horn adds some), crossover recommended at 1.2 kHz (the original T24N's passive filter: 1.6 kHz).
